# packet-void (SPEC §4.8): payload-free union arms cost exactly their tag
# bits. Every leg's driver (test/packet-void/<leg>/) reads this file and
# answers every case on a line of its own, "case <name> ok" or
# "case <name> FAILED: <why>"; tools/casegate refuses a case with no answer.
# The schema is test/packet-void/Void.schema; each case's wire is <name>.bin
# beside this file. README.md says where each pin comes from.
#
#   <name> <type> <verdict> <bits> <value>
#
# accept: the leg writes <value> to exactly the pin's bytes (and <bits>, where
#   the leg's writer reports a bit count), its public one-packet read accepts
#   the pin, and the value it reads writes the pin's bytes again.
# refuse: the leg's public one-packet read refuses the pin. <bits> is "-".
batch-count-3   Batch  refuse -  count 3 > [..2]
batch-empty     Batch  accept 2  values=[]
batch-ping      Batch  accept 4  values=[ping]
batch-ping-payload Batch accept 11 values=[ping,payload]
empty-none      Empty  accept 0  None
empty-trailing  Empty  refuse -  a whole byte after no bits
frame-missing   Frame  refuse -  no bytes
frame-ping      Frame  accept 8  lead=5,choice=ping,tail=6
mixed-count-3   Mixed  refuse -  payload, entries count 3 > [..2]
mixed-missing   Mixed  refuse -  no tag
mixed-none      Mixed  accept 2  None
mixed-padding   Mixed  refuse -  ping, then a set bit in the final byte's padding
mixed-payload   Mixed  accept 7  payload (entries=[], marker=5: its defaults)
mixed-ping      Mixed  accept 2  ping
mixed-short     Mixed  refuse -  payload, entries count 2, and the entries cut off
mixed-tag-3     Mixed  refuse -  tag 3 > MixedTypeMax 2
mixed-trailing  Mixed  refuse -  ping, then a whole zero byte
single-ack      Single accept 1  ack
single-missing  Single refuse -  no tag
single-none     Single accept 1  None
tags-none       Tags   accept 2  None
tags-ping       Tags   accept 2  ping
tags-pong       Tags   accept 2  pong
tags-tag-3      Tags   refuse -  tag 3 > TagsTypeMax 2
